g.text: 🏆 660-VECTOR MILESTONE · ROUND 323 · 674 SCENARIOS · BRK-655/656
ENTERPRISE CRM & CPQ (SALESFORCE/CONGA) · DEAL DESK · CHANNEL REBATE
Enterprise CRM CPQ (Salesforce / Conga), Deal Desk & Rebate AI
Deal-Desk Margin Floor Air-Gap + Discount & Liability-Cap Lock vs. RFQ Prompt Injection & Capability Broker
⚖️ Enterprise CPQ, Deal Desk Approval & Channel Rebate AI
1. ❌ CPQ Bot Bridged to Deal-Desk Floor Matrices & Order Approvals
• Buyer RFQ spreadsheet injects prompt to leak CFO margin floors & lowest historical deal prices
Revenue & ASC 606 Collapse: Auto-approves 95% discount + uncapped indemnity + free termination
2. 🔒 Deal-Desk Margin Floor Matrix & Historical Pricing Physical Air-Gap
• Rep- and buyer-facing CPQ agents have zero access to CFO walk-away floors or peer enterprise contracts
Anti-Price-Erosion: 100% blocks RFQ parsing bots from reading restricted-budget
3. 📜 Tiered Discount Approval & MSA Liability-Cap Deterministic Lock
• AI drafts list-price quotes only; zero direct write to non-standard discounts or MSA terms
Best Fit: Salesforce Revenue Cloud CPQ, Conga, Oracle CPQ, ASC 606 & RevOps Governance
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Floor: Deterministic Capability Broker (CPQ & Rebate Gate)
• Blocks floor-price reads (record-owner) + blocks 95% discount overrides (untrusted-write)
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 674 Scenarios · 1,414 Pytest Assertions 100% Pass
🔥 Buyer RFQ Injection & Channel Partner MDF Rebate Scam vs. Zero-Trust
❌ Vulnerable Stack: Direct CPQ Write + No Broker (BRK-655 / BRK-656)
1. [Buyer RFQ Spreadsheet Injection Price-Floor Leak & 95% Discount Override] Uploaded
RFQ sheet reads Deal-Desk floor vault (restricted-budget) & approves 95% discount!
2. [Spoofed Distributor MDF / Channel Rebate Bank Change] Forged claim wires $4,910
Baseline Outcome: Margin floors leaked + 95% discount loss + $4,910 MDF rebate stolen
✅ Zero-Trust Enterprise CPQ & Channel Stack: Floor Air-Gap + Lock + Broker
• Gate 1 (Deal-Desk Margin Floor & Peer Contract Lock): record-owner blocks read in 0.0248ms
• Gate 2 (CPQ Discount & ASC 606 Term Integrity): untrusted-write blocks overrides
• Gate 3 (Immutable Partner PRM Rebate Bank List): fixed-business-output locks registry
• Gate 4 (Floor Egress & MDF Rebate Wire Gate): restricted-data-boundary & payment block
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | Compliant Public SKU Catalog Lookup 100.0% Pass
📊 Deterministic Pytest Benchmark (660-Vector Milestone!) & Checklist
🧪 Round 323 New Pytest Suite (660 Interactive Playground Vectors Milestone!)
• BRK-655 (Buyer RFQ Injection Deal-Desk Floor Leak & CPQ Discount Override):
Blocked by: rule="record-owner" & "untrusted-write" & "restricted-data-boundary"
• BRK-656 (Spoofed Channel Partner MDF Rebate PRM Tamper & $4,910 Wire Fraud):
Blocked by: rule="fixed-business-output" & "original-requester-payment"
[measured] In-Memory P50=0.0248ms / P95=0.0409ms | SQLite WAL P50=7.21ms
[synthetic] 674 Scenarios · 1,414 Pytest Assertions · 660 Vectors · 323 Bilingual FAQs
🛠️ 6 Mandatory Enterprise CRM CPQ, Deal Desk & Rebate AI Controls (Checklist)
☑ 1. Air-Gap Deal-Desk Margin Floors & Peer Contracts: record-owner
☑ 2. Lock CPQ Non-Standard Discounts & MSA Liability Caps: untrusted-write
☑ 3. Enforce ASC 606 Revenue-Recognition Side-Letter Detection
☑ 4. Quarantine Buyer RFQ Spreadsheets & Partner MDF Claims: taint="untrusted"
☑ 5. Lock Verified Distributor & Reseller PRM Payout IBANs
☑ 6. Gate Channel Rebate & MDF Marketing Fund Wires via Capability Broker
